protocol: centred fields h = ln RMS - mean(ln RMS) on raw W; row field for q/k/v/gate/up, column field for v/o/down; stats: sd (=H^W), IQR, skew, excess kurtosis, q05/q95, PR=(sum e^2h)^2/(n sum e^4h), Sarle BC (>5/9 flags), Hartigan dip + p (diptest)
bimodality_method: diptest (Hartigan dip, p-value) and Sarle BC
